data.notes: January 2026 was heavy on pre-Carnival soca, calypso and steelpan programming around Port of Spain, with major fetes clustering on the final weekend of the month.

events.title: French Toast "The Breakfast & Bacchanal Fete"
events.summary: House of Siete billed French Toast as the official breakfast fete to start Trinidad Carnival 2026. The event was confirmed for Queen Hall, St Ann on Sunday, January 4, 2026.

events.title: Mical Teja | MAS The Experience '26
events.summary: Mical Teja presented MAS The Experience as a Carnival culture-and-music event at Queen's Hall Gardens. The ticket page listed it for January 11–12, 2026 from 5:00 PM to midnight.

events.title: NEON - The Lit Fete
events.summary: WinerBoy Entertainment's NEON - The Lit Fete was listed as a music and Carnival event at Queen's Park Oval. TicketGateway confirmed the date as January 16–17, 2026, 9:00 PM–3:00 AM.

events.title: Phoenix The Festival
events.summary: Holy Name Convent's Phoenix The Festival returned as a food-inclusive cooler experience with a soca-artiste lineup. The event page confirmed January 17, 2026 at 2 Queen's Park East, Port of Spain.

events.title: National Junior Panorama Finals 2026
events.summary: Pan Trinbago confirmed the National Junior Panorama Finals for January 18, 2026 at Queen's Park Savannah. The steelpan finals featured 21 & Under and 19 & Under categories.

events.title: D'Kaiso Dynasty
events.summary: D'Kaiso Dynasty was a TUCO calypso-tent night at the Radisson Hotel on Wrightson Road. The January 31 listing named a large cast including Brother Valentino, Gypsy, Karene Asche, Yung Bredda, Rikki Jai, Preedy and others.

events.title: Soaka Arts + Music Fest Weekend
events.summary: Soaka Arts + Music Fest Weekend bundled three official events from January 23–25, 2026: Iron Park, wOw Carnival Market and Soaka Till Sunrise. The festival focused on Carnival music, steelpan culture, DJs, paint, powder and soca energy.

events.title: Soca Village - For the Love of Soca Music
events.summary: House of Siete's Soca Village was positioned as a throwback soca fete focused on soca from the 1980s through the present. Island E-Tickets confirmed it for January 24–25, 2026 at Rock Back, Chaguaramas.

events.title: QRC Fete: Ramajay
events.summary: QRC Events confirmed Fete Royal: Ramajay as a Carnival 2026 fete at Queen's Royal College Grounds. The event was scheduled for January 31–February 1, 2026 from 6:30 PM to 2:00 AM.

events.title: Fete Gala
events.summary: Fete Gala was listed as an all-inclusive Carnival experience at Queen's Park Oval. Soca News confirmed the event for January 31–February 1, 2026 from 6:00 PM to 2:00 AM.

events.title: SOTU presents Enamour
events.summary: SOTU presented Enamour at Club Vice on Cipriani Boulevard. The listing described Enamour's sound as deep house, progressive and dark techno, with the event running January 31–February 1, 2026.
